besluite.fout: 'oor blink metaal' reads as a generic statement where the sentence means the metal of the old copper and silver itself.
besluite.rede: The article ties the shiny metal to the object under the layer and prepares 'die blink metaal' in the next sentence, without changing the claim.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining 'Skuur haal die lagie af' and 'die blink metaal wys weer'.
besluite.rede: Two clauses each with their own subject and verb take the comma under the AWS 2017.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' between two full clauses; 'geen sulke lagie nie' is stiff for a singular noun.
besluite.rede: The comma is required and 'nie so 'n lagie nie' is the natural singular form, with the negation and meaning unchanged.

besluite.fout: The sentence says someone bends the chalk while saying it does not bend, which makes a reader stumble.
besluite.rede: 'probeer buig' removes the self-contradiction and keeps the claim that chalk breaks instead of bending.

besluite.fout: 'Daardie selfde' copies English 'that same', and 'hom' for a stone is informal in written study text.
besluite.rede: 'Dieselfde' and 'dit' are the standard written forms and the sentence says exactly the same; the protected thumb sentence before it is untouched.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining 'kryt bly dof' and ''n skoon koperdraad blink helder'.
besluite.rede: Two clauses each with their own subject and verb take the comma under the AWS 2017.

besluite.fout: 'besluit wat hulle waarmee maak' is a compressed double-question construction that a Grade 5 reader stumbles over.
besluite.rede: Checked the preposition: both say people choose which material to make a thing from, which the next two sentences ('van metaal gemaak', 'van klip gebou') confirm, so the meaning holds and the sentence is easier to read.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining 'Draad word van metaal gemaak' and 'dit kan krom gaan'.
besluite.rede: Two clauses each with their own subject and verb take the comma under the AWS 2017.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining 'Mure word van klip gebou' and 'klip hoef nooit te buig nie'.
besluite.rede: Two clauses each with their own subject and verb take the comma under the AWS 2017.

besluite.fout: 'Albei soorte' has no noun, so the reader has to work out that metal and stone are meant.
besluite.rede: Adding 'materiaal' names what the two kinds are without adding any fact, and the paragraph already uses that word.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining 'Daar is baie verskillende nie-metale' and 'hulle eienskappe verskil baie van mekaar'.
besluite.rede: Two clauses each with their own subject and verb take the comma under the AWS 2017.
'Baie plastiek' (many plastic things) is natural, and 'baie soorte plastiek' moves the claim to kinds of plastic, when whether plastic shines depends on its surface finish rather than its kind.
